title: Diagnosing Drainage Issues Through Vent Stacks
description: When a plumbing drain gurgles or drains slowly despite a clear trap, the root cause is often hidden in the drainage ventilation system. Without proper air intake, wastewater flow creates negative pressure that siphons trap seals and stalls movement. Professional troubleshooters know to inspect the roof vent termination for blockages like leaves, nests, or ice buildup before tearing into walls or floors. Understanding how atmospheric pressure interacts with gravity drainage saves time and prevents unnecessary pipe replacement. Always check your vents first when multiple fixtures share sluggish drainage behavior.
